data.title: Microsoft addressed a critical 'Perfect 10' exploit, scoring max severity. The Entra ID flaw is fixed with no evidence of exploitation.
data.description: The Entra ID vulnerability was rated with the highest severity score by Microsoft. However, the tech giant confirmed that they had already addressed the issue before releasing the Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) report. Microsoft also stated that there was no indication that the vulnerability had ever been taken advantage of by malicious actors.

data.title: Dr. Gary Lawton Defines Standards for Choosing a Breast Augmentation Surgeon in San Antonio
data.description: A plastic surgeon, who received education at Yale and is board-certified, discusses key factors to consider when selecting a surgeon for breast procedures. These factors include independent experience, specialization in breast surgery, ability to perform revisions, emphasis on operative safety, and a track record of documented results. This guidance was shared in San Antonio on August 22, 2026. For patients seeking optimal outcomes for breast surgeries, such as augmentation or reconstruction, these criteria are crucial in making an informed decision.

data.title: Tallgrass Announces Open Season for the Seahorse Pipeline
data.description: The Seahorse Pipeline, LLC, in partnership with Bridger Pipeline LLC, has launched a new binding joint tariff open season aimed at offering incentive tariff rates for the transportation of crude oil from Bridger's Guernsey Hub. Shippers are invited to make commitments utilizing the existing capacity, with the open season lasting for 30 days starting from August 21, 2026. Interested shippers can participate in this rate program by reviewing the open season details post signing a confidentiality agreement.

data.title: U.S. Steel Stocks Nucor, Steel Dynamics: Big Winners As Canada Trade Talks Collapse?
data.description: Last week, shares of Nucor and Steel Dynamics saw a decrease in value due to the anticipation of reduced steel tariffs. This decline came amid the collapse of trade talks between the US and Canada. Despite this, U.S. Steel stocks, including Nucor and Steel Dynamics, were reported as significant beneficiaries in the aftermath of the trade disagreement. Investors may be closely observing these developments as they navigate the shifting landscape of the steel industry.

data.title: Bitcoin software faces AI threats as a team of 20 developers scans for flaws. They warn of powerful models helping attackers reach new levels.
data.description: A team of around 20 developers is currently conducting a scan of the Bitcoin ecosystem in search of vulnerabilities that can be identified using artificial intelligence. They are cautioning that the accessibility of low-cost, high-performance AI models has enabled cyber attackers to have an unprecedented level of access.
